_comment: The 'p'-as-dot version decode. Two kinds of row: the UNIT rows probe decodePNotationVersion directly (token -> decoded form, or must-fail for a token that must NOT decode), and the CATALOG rows pin every digit-p-digit model id in the committed registry to the entity key it resolves to. The catalog set is exactly 14 ids, all from fireworks-ai and kimi-for-coding; a census sweep asserts that confinement separately. See TESTING.md.

Pinned so the defect is visible and its future fix is a conscious census move
